identity_boundary: Han Hong Gil, listed by OFAC as HAN, Hong Gil with the Korean name 한홍길 and alternate spelling HAN, Hong Kil, is the bank employee described in Treasury's November 2025 sanctions action. The record preserves the administrative-designation posture; criminal case, precise present location, and same-named account ownership require separate sources.
